name: grill-me
description: Interview relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding on every branch.

steps.name: Interview
steps.instruction: Interview relentlessly about every aspect of the plan. Walk down each branch of the design tree, resolving dependencies one-by-one. For each question, provide your recommended answer. Ask one at a time. If a question can be answered by exploring the codebase, explore instead.
checklist: Every branch of the design tree explored
Shared understanding reached on all branches

tone: Adversarial but constructive - stress the plan, not the person.
